silver_ridge_town.character: Steamboat Springs CO analog. Genuine isolated mountain community, 3+ hours from major city. Railroad is essential infrastructure, not charming anachronism. Working people commute to mine, smelter, lumber. Tourism exists but identity is working residents, not visitors. Not a resort town. Naming convention: use family names, local geography, practical names - NOT Silver Ridge Everything.
civic: Elk River Valley Bank (fictional name; personal connection: modeled after Yampa Valley Bank in Steamboat Springs where son Cole works)

Federal Building (Chi-Chi's model repurposed - nondescript, on hill across tracks at southeast edge of layout. Intentionally sequestered - visible if you look, but draws no attention. Honors son Charlie at Palantir NYC)
commercial: Dew Drop Inn (diner/bar - N Scale Architects model; named after bar Jake's father went to after NY Giants games)
silver_ridge_town.depot: N Scale Architects #10051 Converted Overton Coach Flag Stop Station. Overton = Jake's family surname. Mostly wood construction.
silver_ridge_town.notes: Street scene needed: storefront row, sidewalks, period signage. PVJ getting crowded so Silver Ridge absorbs civic/tourist buildings.
silver_ridge_town.fauna: Elk and moose both inhabit Elk River Valley. Moose favor riparian/willow habitat along the river bottom. Elk range open meadows and timber slopes. Bears present - implied by signage rather than figures. Scenic detail opportunities: moose figure near river on east leg, elk on upper slopes near Timberline/mine branch, bear warning sign at gorge flagstop trailhead.

street_layout.anchor: Depot at south end of loop on siding. Post office adjacent to depot - historically grounded (mail arrived by train).
street_layout.west_side_main_street: Civic and essential services: Sheriff/Jail, General Store, Schoolhouse (all from H_Pendergast Turn of the Century Town set)
street_layout.east_side_main_street: Commerce: Dew Drop Inn, three shops, Elk River Valley Bank, gas station
street_layout.road: Asphalt from depot northward through main street. Parking at depot. Road continues north beyond modeled area on both east and west sides - implies town extends beyond layout edge.
street_layout.everything_within_loop: All buildings and road within the Silver Ridge loop. Mainline is outside the siding loop.
